sources</title><link>https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/50247083/man-united-players-day-como-thrashing</link><description>Manchester United's first-team squad will report back for training on Friday after being given a day off on Thursday following the humiliating 4-1 Champions League defeat against Como, sources have told ESPN.</description><pubDate>Thu, 22 Oct 2026 16:01:23 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1022/r1734431_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>José Mourinho complains Real Madrid have 24 hours less rest than Barcelona ahead of El Clásico</title><link>https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/50247061/jose-mourinho-real-madrid-barcelona-el-clasico-less-rest</link><description>Real Madrid coach José Mourinho was keen to point out after his side's win over Leipzig that his team will have 24 hours less rest than Sunday's rivals Barcelona heading into the Clásico.</description><pubDate>Thu, 22 Oct 2026 10:31:36 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1022/r1734427_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Mourinho made Real Madrid-Barcelona Clásico rivalry unmissable.
